svg.title: Artel — coding agents in an isolated copy of your project
svg.desc: Artel is a DeepSeek Harness plugin. A live Swarm run card and a per-file diff card float over a dark violet workspace; on the left, the Artel wordmark, the line "Coding agents in an isolated copy of your project.", five run modes and the install command.
svg.text: Review the diff. Apply it yourself.

g.text: Add a pow(a, b) function to src/math.js
// Raise a to the power b.
